reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the $29.99 and the 30 sachets, and that works out to a dollar a day, when my Toplux bottle cost half of that and lasted 3 months. The lab-tested QR is nice, but I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles and I wait for flash sales.
